clips.title: Quest text
paras: The winds o' Azeroth greet ye, and soon ye'll stand among some o' our mightiest kin. I'm proud to see how far ye've come--your future looks bright indeed.
The element o' air's a tricky one to master, but I've faith your skill will see ye through any challenge.
Make your way north into Arathi Highlands. In its northern hills, you'll find Veyric Thundervein. He'll teach ye more.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
